newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil adds hydroelectric plants to sell-off list.
newsitem.headline: Brazil adds hydroelectric plants to sell-off list.

text.p: Brazil's National Privatization Council (CND) Tuesday added nine partially- completed hydroelectricity plants to its privatization list, said Planning Minister Antonio Kandir.

Kandir told reporters the government hoped to earn some 2.7 billion reais in privatization receipts from concessions to run the projects, which are expected to produce a total of 2.3 megawatts of energy.

The plants are Bom Retiro in Rio Grande do Sul state, Itapebi in Bahia, Itumirim in Goias, Jataizinho in Parana, Lageado in Tocantins, Picada in Minas Gerais, Piraju in Sao Paulo, Santa Clara between Bahia and Minas Gerais and Simplicio between Rio de Janeiro and Minas Gerais.
Kandir said all the hydroelectric plants were still being completed, but were at different stages of construction.
